# Vocabulary

*Generated by `tools/vocabulary_reference.py`. Do not edit by hand — re-run the tool; `pytest` fails if this file is out of date.*

Every axis a bound can be selected along. Two kinds: values carried by each bound in its own header, and classes assigned to instruments, targets and channels in the legend files.

In code, `gdmbounds.load_vocabulary()` returns the same information, and `.describe()` prints it.

---

# Carried by each bound

## Process

Recorded in every bound's header as `mode`.

| value | meaning |
|---|---|
| `ann` | annihilation |
| `dec` | decay |

Fixed by the physics of the result and never inferred.

## Provenance

Recorded in every bound's header as `origin`.

| value | meaning |
|---|---|
| `collaboration` | published by the experiment collaboration |
| `author` | forecast or reinterpretation by individual authors |

Separates a collaboration's own result from an analysis of public data published by individual authors.

## Kind of statement

Recorded in every bound's header as `statement`.

| value | meaning |
|---|---|
| `limit` | upper limit derived from observed data |
| `sensitivity` | projected reach of an instrument or exposure |
| `detection` | claimed signal region rather than an exclusion |

Plotting a projected sensitivity beside a measured limit without distinguishing them is the most misleading thing this database could do.

## Assumed halo profile

Recorded in every bound's header as `profile`.

| value | meaning |
|---|---|
| `nfw` | Navarro-Frenk-White, including contracted and rescaled variants |
| `einasto` | Einasto |
| `burkert` | Burkert |
| `isothermal` | isothermal / cored isothermal |
| `cored` | cored, family unspecified |
| `cusped` | cusped, family unspecified |

**Optional.** Recorded where the source states it. A missing `profile` means nobody wrote it down, *not* that no profile was assumed — every J-factor rests on one. Any selection filtering on it silently drops the bounds that do not declare one, and should say so.

# Assigned in the legends

## Instrument classes

Assigned in `gdmbounds/legends/legend_instruments.ecsv` in the `class` column, and validated against the set below.

| class | meaning | n | members |
|---|---|---|---|
| `iact` | Imaging Atmospheric Cherenkov Telescope | 6 | `cangaroo`, `ctao`, `hess`, `magic`, `veritas`, `whipple` |
| `satellite` | satellite-borne pair-conversion detector | 3 | `agile`, `dampe`, `lat` |
| `xray` | satellite-borne X-ray telescope | 1 | `nustar` |
| `sfd` | shower-front detector array | 3 | `hawc`, `lhaaso`, `swgo` |
| `radio` | radio interferometer | 1 | `mwa` |
| `collider` | collider search | 1 | `collider` |
| `direct` | direct-detection experiment | 1 | `directsearches` |
| `combined` | joint analysis across instruments | 1 | `multi-inst` |

| `galaxy` | galaxy | 4 | `LMC`, `m31`, `m33`, `wlm` |

## Channel spectra

Assigned in `gdmbounds/legends/legend_channels.ecsv` in the `spectrum` column, and validated against the set below.

| class | meaning | n | members |
|---|---|---|---|
| `continuum` | broad spectrum from hadronisation or cascade | 14 | `4e`, `4mu`, `WW`, `ZZ`, `bb`, `cc`, `ee`, `gg`, `hh`, `mumu`, `qq`, `tautau`, `tt`, `uu` |
| `line` | monochromatic feature at the dark matter mass | 2 | `Zgamma`, `gammagamma` |
| `model` | specific model with both line and continuum features | 3 | `KK`, `quintuplett`, `triplett` |
| `benchmark` | individual benchmark points rather than a curve | 1 | `points` |


---

# Adding a value

A new class goes in `schema.py`, beside the set it joins, with a sentence saying what it means. A new instrument, target or channel goes in the matching legend file **with its class filled in** — `pytest` fails on a blank or misspelled one. Then re-run this tool.
